cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Name What It Cost
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge the emotional cost of what happened, not merely the event itself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Tell me you understand why six weeks of silence hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. For me, the silence didn't come with a repair notice.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Can you understand why I kept rewriting a message you'd never answered, trying to become easier to reply to?

mechanism: A uses its pupil empathy training to demand recognition of how unanswered contact changed A view of its own worth.
confusable: Not seeking only apology for a broken phone: A asks for the continuing emotional consequence.
comparison: A missed public event versus private messages rewritten during prolonged silence.
